card.name: Digits inside long ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 0 or 1) in the middle of a long identifier number, such as an ISBN, PubMed ID, phone number or compound code like GS-33107.

modes.label: Book and database IDs
modes.description: Digit partway through an ISBN or PubMed number.

modes.label: Compound code numbers
modes.description: Digit inside the numeric part of a drug metabolite code.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it may favor more digit-like or number-part continuations.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a long reference or phone number.
